text:
eva: Quick sync 4: we need a consolidated checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure listing go/no-go. I put a proto in Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace/checklists/go-no-go-1757. Can someone own finalizing?

maurice: I can. Will verify offerId mapping, regional pricing buckets, and SKU visibility.

hana: I'll own assets and copy. Need confirmation on image sizes for each store (AWS hero, GCP banner, Azure thumbnail). asset-bot, can you re-run the image spec check? :eyes:

asset-bot: image-check: AWS hero recommended 3:2, max 1MB; GCP banner 16:9, max 750KB; Azure thumbnail 1:1, max 500KB. Upload path: /drive/marketplace/1757/assets.

kevin: Legal note: Marketplace listing must include explicit data-handling blurb and KMS mention for private offers. Also confirm trial length. Proposed 14d.

legal: 14-day trial is fine. Include: "Data retained for service operation and deleted on request within 30 days" and a link to privacy FAQ. Tag me when copy is in.

eva: Good. Maurice, can you also flag any internal SKU collisions? We had one last sprint.

maurice: Found RED-BETA collision with internal experiments. Will rename to RED-BETA-LEGACY in mapping and exclude from publisher manifest. Pushing spreadsheet to Drive.

hana: Drafted listing blurb and three feature bullets in the doc: product/marketplace/blurb-1757.md. Will add alt text to images and upload compressed variants tonight.

publish-bot: staging-publish: bundle-412 deployed to publisher-staging accounts for aws/gcp/azure. Manifest: manifest-1757-v1.json attached. Use that for validation.

kevin: One more: Azure private offers require offerId + planId pair. Maurice pls produce mapping per region with those fields.

maurice: On it. ETA EOD. Also doing a quick test of the meter definitions for per-seat vs per-instance billing. For now we're shipping single paid SKU + trial SKU to avoid marketplace metering complexity.

legal: Also ensure the EULA doc has placeholders for trial conversion behavior and refund policy. I'll approve after placeholders filled.

eva: Action recap: maurice (offerId/planId mapping + collision remap), hana (assets + copy + alt text), kevin/legal (final EULA and privacy lines), publish-bot confirmed staging bundle. Preflight review Thu 10am PT. Thanks all :white_check_mark:

maurice: noted, will upload mapping.

hana: uploading compressed assets now.

eva: Adding calendar invite for Thu 10am PT: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/marketplace-preflight-1757

kevin: I'll be there.

legal: Ping when copy updated.

eva: Closing thread, will re-open if blockers pop up. :sparkles:
